create_IrOpPriorityConfig: create an IrOpPriorityConfig to set IR op priority for dispatching and lowering during the forward pass
build_IrOpPriorityConfig_with_default: build an IrOpPriorityConfig with a given default priority list applied to all unspecified fields
run_IrOpPriorityConfig_set_priority: run the IrOpPriorityConfig context manager to set IR op priorities for all registered ops
test_KernelConfig_compute_hash: test the KernelConfig compute_hash method to generate a unique compilation cache key
review_KernelConfig_set_platform_default: review the KernelConfig set_platform_defaults method to apply platform-specific IR op priority defaults
